gloss: to stand frozen; to be rooted to the spot

definitions.gloss: to stand frozen; to be rooted to the spot
definitions.explanation: To stand motionless, unable to move, due to fear, shock, or overwhelming emotion.

examples.japanese: {恐怖|きょうふ}で{立|た}ちすくんだ。
{突然|とつぜん}の{大|おお}きな{音|おと}に{立|た}ちすくんだ。
examples.english: I froze in place at the sudden loud noise.

examples.japanese: {目|め}の{前|まえ}に{熊|くま}が{現|あらわ}れて、{立|た}ちすくむしかなかった。
examples.english: A bear appeared right in front of me, and all I could do was stand frozen.

notes: A compound verb from {立|た}つ (to stand) and すくむ (to cower/stiffen). Intransitive. Implies being unable to move despite wanting to. Strongly associated with fear or shock, but can also describe being overwhelmed by awe or beauty. Related: {足|あし}がすくむ (legs freeze with fear), {身|み}がすくむ (body freezes up).
